questions.question: At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Leah Jones holds it with 19, a joint record shared with Nosipho Vezi.

questions.question: It took South Africa Women 23 attempts before they finally beat Australia for the first time in any format. When did that first win come?
questions.explanation: South Africa beat Australia for the first time in a T20I at Manuka Oval, Canberra, on 28 January 2024, having lost 22 of the previous 23 meetings and tied one, in 2016.

questions.question: At which ground did Megan Wessels record their career-best innings (56, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/10/29.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Limpopo Lillies?
Who has achieved the century and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Suné Luus or Mieke van Voorst?
questions.explanation: Suné Luus: 2 times. Mieke van Voorst: 1 times.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval — highest total of 137, against Rhinos on 2015/03/15.
